cases.name: Verify that when the shop description owns content, you can open the profile drawer by clicking ">" and return to the shop via Links

steps.desc: 1. Click on "My shop" and click on the profile description or profile picture to enter Edit profile
steps.result: 1. The Edit profile page is displayed

steps.desc: 2. Add a description, then click "Back", then click "Save"
steps.result: 2. The shop description is successfully added, and ">" appears next to the description.

steps.desc: 3. Click ">" and then click the "Links" icon
steps.result: 3. The profile drawer pops up, and then the Links page
4. Return to the shop page successfully

cases.name: Verify that after deleting the background image, the shop background image will be the default green color

steps.desc: 1. Click on "My shop" and click on the profile description or profile picture to enter Edit profile
steps.result: 1. The Edit profile page is displayed

steps.desc: 2. Click "X" next to "Background image" and click "Save"
steps.result: 2. The Background image is deleted and the profile is saved

steps.desc: 3. Click "Back" in the top left corner
steps.result: 3. Return to the shop page. The shop background will be green by default

cases.name: Verify that manually written Links beginning with "www", copying and pasting into "Links" will automatically have "https"

steps.desc:
1. Manually write links that start with "www"
2. Click "+ Add link" in Edit profile-Links
3. Copy and paste to "Links" and click "Save"
steps.result: Manually written links beginning with "www", copying and pasting into "links" will automatically have "https".
